Puma Browser for iOS and Android

Yuriy Dybskiy
Apr 5, 2019 #1

Hi everyone,

My brother @416serg and I have been working on this for a while and today we are happy to launch the Early Preview of Puma Browser!

Today we support Coil.com and our goal is to support ILP in general.
Longer term we’ll be adding more feature for better privacy and UX of mobile browser.

Any feedback and thoughts are much appreciated!

You can signup with/DM your Apple ID if you’re on iPhone/iPad and we’ll get you a TestFlight build. We have a rough APK for android too – ping us for one

Huge thanks to @justmoon @sharafian @traviscrist @vanessadice @emschwartz @ethan and the rest of Coil and Xpring teams for making this possible!
